test_title: PYST 21: SSC CGL - Reasoning (Held On : 21 April 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

CANOPY : DCQSUE :: TONSIL : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

**Logic : E**ach letter according to their position within the word **is rearranged by next letter, when counting from left to right.**

So,

 
• CANOPY : DCQSUE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42fd6650c84d604016d5b6358e3503937eeca70cb2ac325712639e9abf2e5970.png] 

Similarly,

 
• TONSIL : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ff94acde6d89ac61f9066bda52d759b8f23299da7901b45d18cc2d608b5738e.png] 

Hence, **"****UQQWNR"** is the correct answer.
